messages:
Priya Rao: Partner raised SEV1 from marketplace listing — customers hitting degraded inference latency and GPU errors. Do we open public ack or private warroom?
Luis Mendes: Private warroom, ack in channel. Quick flow: ACK -> create `#partner-warroom-<name>-sev1` -> add vendor POC + Marketplace Oncall -> attach telemetry links.
Zoe Tan: Add one-line ownership: EngOncall=triage+evidence; PartnerOps=vendor comms; AE=customer comms.
Priya Rao: Minimal starter template suggestion: include marketplace_listing_id, region, infra ids, model variant (fp16/int8), and GPU serials.
Marketplace Oncall: Escalation windows: vendor ACK 10m; escalate PD vendor-eng 15m; loop AM/AE at 20m. If dedicated infra, tag `dedicated_customer_id`.
vendor-bot: Created vendor ticket VND-9002; ETA for first response: 18m.
Luis Mendes: Note for SI partners: include support token and whether SI manages infra — affects who performs swaps.
Priya Rao: I'll draft the warroom naming + initial post automation and add it to Partner SEV playbook. ETA tomorrow noon.
Zoe Tan: Add postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause, vendor action, credits decision + owner.
Priya Rao: Thanks — dropping vendor PDs into the playbook after QA. Closing thread; will create warroom if partner confirms impact.
